case_selection: First sorted eligible ITU interval detected byseed7 and missed byseed42
contexts: First and middle available full3s context per case, aligned to0.5s. Same waveform for every model; do not infer audible presence within weakly labelled files.
decision_check: Read saved scores only. Compare existing thresholds with the theoretical within-FPV zero-negative-file ceiling, then test one shared two-hit threshold respecting <=5% negative-file FPR separately on original development and consumed FPV. No changes to product or claim of independent improvement.

arms: fixed STFT power reference1, raw amplitude
fixed STFT power reference1, bounded common waveform RMS target0.05, max+20dB, peak0.98
learning_task.data: Same published ITU one-second segments and interval-disjoint split, now explicitly consumed diagnostic data. Retain published class labels; not newly verified audible labels.
learning_task.input: Same1s waveform,16kHz mono,4096Hann,256hop,256uniform-Hz bands50-7600,47 complete frames. No padding.
learning_task.neural: Existing154689-parameter frequency-aware CNN, dropout0, Adam0.001 per-tensor clipnorm1, convolution L2=1e-4,24epochs,batch64,seeds42and7. Same seed and batch order across normalization arms.
learning_task.non_neural: Train-only standardized512 per-frequency temporal mean/std descriptors plus C1 logistic regression on identical inputs and sample weights. No hyperparameter sweep.
learning_task.outcome: Report segment and interval-block metrics by split, both seeds, exact target/input differences from original detector, normalization effects and matched initial weights. No product promotion.
learning_task.selection: Minimum deterministic weighted validation segment BCE every2epochs. Retain last and selected weights. Fixed0.5 classification threshold; no threshold tuning.
learning_task.target: Per-segment BCE on the publisher-released one-second labels, not full-recording max labels. This deliberately simplifies the target to test learnability; it is not proof each segment is audibly positive.
learning_task.weights: Equal source-interval/block mass within each class and equal class mass; fit on train only.

primary_question: What acoustic structure do repaired scratch CNNs use, and can they learn a matched-duration, within-condition target before broader source transfer?

probes.tensor: Per-band temporal mean repeated; common random time permutation; independent per-band time permutations. Ten fixed permutations per context. The last two preserve marginal spectra; independent permutations break cross-band synchronization. Nonphysical tensor interventions, not new acoustic trials.
probes.waveform: Uniform0.25 gain and piecewise0.25 gain in the second half with10ms taper; diagnostics only.

scope: Consumed-data diagnosis and a simplified released-label learning task; no fresh reliability claim or architecture expansion.
source_search: Audit public original human annotations for audibility, negative coverage, capture sessions and licence. Kenya Forest and IDMT Berne metadata are candidates only; do not score fresh audio before qualifying and freezing a new panel.
